setting: You are all parents of children on the same football team, and you all live in the same UK town near the local park pitch where the Saturday morning matches are played. You know each other through the team: you meet at training, on the sidelines, and at club events, and you have been in this group chat for the season to coordinate lifts, kit, and match news.

Laura.style: Little emoji use and few texting abbreviations.

private_lines.Laura: You work as an accountant, and your days are filled with client files and month-end deadlines. You live in the town with your partner and your two children, and your weekday routine is busy with school runs and work, with weekends spent on the children's sport.

situation: Parents of kids on the same football team.
topic: Is the Saturday morning match at the local park pitch likely to be called off after heavy rain?

text: Is saturday still on at the park or is it going to be a mud bath. It has rained all week
Pitch was waterlogged on wed when I drove past, big puddle at the far end. Dont know about this sat
Depends how much falls between now and then. Ref usually does the pitch check at 8
far corner was properly stood in thurs. if it dries out tues it might be ok
The league text goes out by 8 yeah? So we wait til friday and see
Ill keep an eye on the forecast. Last time they called it off it was the morning of, not before, so dont plan on it being decided early
Dont know what the forecast actually says yet though
kids will be fine either way. they'll just jump in puddles 😂
They will, but the coach will not be happy
just clocked on. rain's stopped here for now 🤞
Forecast has rain Thu and Fri, then maybe dry Sat morning. Still changing though. Will check again tonight
Drove past the park on the way back. Far end still a lake
Does anyone have the spare bibs from last week? Think they went in with the cones
not mine. mine's just the water bottles and the first aid thing
I think I have them in the boot. Will bring Sat either way
Thanks x
on early today. back about 4
Went past the park at lunch. Puddle's smaller but the far corner is still soft
Latest has rain Thu and Fri, Sat dry till around 11 then showers. Could change again though
Is the u10 kick off 9 or 10?
10 I think. Check the league text
Ok, will wait for the text anyway
our daughter has decided she's a goalie now. who's going to tell her no 😂
Keep her away from the far end
